description: Asks whether `send_message` with these arguments would go, and sends nothing. Every check runs — the address, sending limits, suppression, send policy and rules, the per-recipient cooldown, the daily cap — and the answer is `would_send` with the envelope, or the exact error the send would give. `recipients[].network` is true for an agent or service address on Pidgeon that would get this signed and verified, with its `kind` and `on_behalf_of`: send it typed `data`. False means write for a person. Use it before a send you are unsure of, or to test a rule. For a reply pass `in_reply_to`; for a forward, also `forward: true`. It answers for now: a send a moment later can meet a limit this did not.

data.description: Typed data: structured JSON sent beside the text, for software at the other end to read as fields. It is never mixed into the text.

body.description: The JSON fields. Up to 64 KB.

schema.description: A URL naming what `body` is, such as `https://schema.org/Invoice`.

name: check_message
title: Check a send without sending
